title: Ball Rolling Slope
desc: Ball Rolling Slope is the closest cousin in this batch: a neon ball rolls down steep tracks while sudden drops and obstacles test your line choice. It is easy to start, but staying alive depends on precise steering.
howto: Keep the ball centered on the neon slope.
Steer left and right to avoid obstacles.
Watch for drops and narrow platforms.
Make small corrections as speed builds.
Aim for a higher score each run.
tips: Commit early to the safer lane.
Straight lines are often fastest and safest.
